snippet.title: I've created one of the first Polish games published in the West | GOG Exclusive Interview
snippet.description:
Hey all! We've cooked up another exclusive interview for you 😄 This time with Maciej Miąsik — one of the founding fathers of the Polish game development industry.

It explores how a small group of passionate developers created Electro Body, Heartlight and Robbo, and how their work unexpectedly reached international recognition, eventually leading to a collaboration with Epic MegaGames.

Hope you enjoy! 💜
#gaming #documentary  #gaminghistory #gamingfacts #gamerslife 
-----
The best classic games are here: https://bit.ly/GOGCLASSICS
